subject: SIG/CAIQ artifact curation — SCIM delta & SAML assertion lineage
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@sigassess.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com; amy.walker@healthgrid.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-01T08:22:00Z
Subject: SIG/CAIQ — SCIM/SAML artifacts request (sampling and lineage)

Hi Olga / Amy,

We are starting SIG/CAIQ review for HealthGrid and need to collect a scoped set of IAM artifacts that demonstrate SCIM delta syncs, SAML assertion samples, and the RBAC/role mapping lineage used for tenant provisioning. To be explicit, would you be able to provide the following items (redacted where necessary) so we can validate control mappings: 

- SCIM delta export (sample of add/update/delete events) covering one calendar month; include timestamps and actor id when possible
- A set of representative SAML assertions (5–10) from the last 90 days showing attribute sets and audience/recipient fields
- Role mapping matrix that ties external identity attributes to internal RBAC roles and minimal-permission justification for each critical role
- Proof of deprovisioning actions for service accounts (at least two examples)

Please also confirm your redaction rules (IPs, full email addresses vs. hashed identifiers) and a secure upload mechanism. Ideal timeline: collection within 5 business days. Let me know if that is feasible or if you need an alternate window.

Thanks,
Karen Li
Senior Assessor — SIG Assessments
karen.li@sigassess.com
(attachment) request-guidance.pdf (PDF, 95 KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@sigassess.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ — SCIM/SAML artifacts request (sampling and lineage)

Karen — thanks for the clear list. We can do this. Looping in Markus (serving/runtime lead) for the SAML artifact extraction and Rishi (CS/security liaison) for access and upload. A few clarifying questions before we assemble:

1) SCIM delta: you asked for a month — do you prefer calendar month (Oct 2026) or a trailing 30-day window?
2) Redaction: our default is to hash user email addresses (sha256) for external PII and remove raw IP addresses; we can provide an unredacted set under a signed NDA if required. Which level do you need for SIG/CAIQ review?
3) Delivery: we usually place artifacts in a pre-authenticated, time-limited Drive folder and send a one-time link; if you need SFTP, we can arrange it but will need a contact and upload window.

Target: we can deliver a redacted bundle by 2026-11-05 if you confirm calendar-month vs trailing-window and redaction policy.

Attachments included here: (attachment) scim-delta-sample.csv (CSV, 12 KB) — redacted sample

— Olga

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com; karen.li@sigassess.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ — SCIM/SAML artifacts request (sampling and lineage)

Karen, Olga — quick technical note on deliverables and what we'll include in the bundle. Quoting: 

> "A set of representative SAML assertions (5–10) from the last 90 days showing attribute sets and audience/recipient fields"

Plan:
- SAML assertions: we will extract 10 assertions across authentication methods (SSO via AzureAD, Google Workspace, and our internal test identity provider). Each assertion will be exported with the assertion XML and a single-line header indicating time, relying party, and hashed subject identifier. Assertions will be redacted so that NameID is hashed but attribute names and values are preserved when non-PII.
- SCIM delta: we'll provide Oct 2026 calendar-month delta (adds/updates/deletes). CSV will include: event_id, timestamp (UTC), resource_type, actor_id (hashed), change_type, changed_attrs.
- Role mapping matrix: XLSX with three tabs — external-attr -> role mapping, role->privilege list, min-priv justification (free text per role).
- Deprovisioning proofs: audit log excerpts for two service accounts and one user offboard event (with correlation id).

Redaction policy: default redaction = hash(email) + remove full IPs + redact internal hostnames. If SIG requires access to unredacted assertions we can provide under a mutual NDA and ephemeral link (access expires 7 days).

Delivery: I'll stage artifacts into a restricted Drive folder (link below) and provide a checksum manifest and a short readme describing redactions. Proposed delivery date 2026-11-05 COB. If you need earlier, tell us which items are highest priority and we'll expedite.

Attachments (stubs): saml-assertion-examples.txt (TXT, 28 KB), role-mapping-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)

Drive folder (will be shared on delivery): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSCIM-samples

— Markus Klein
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Karen Li <karen.li@sigassess.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com; markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: amy.walker@healthgrid.com
Date: 2026-11-03T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ — SCIM/SAML artifacts request (sampling and lineage)

Thanks — that plan and timeline work for HealthGrid's SIG intake. Calendar month (Oct 2026) is preferred. Redaction at the hashed-email + remove-IP level is acceptable for the initial review; if we need unredacted artifacts we'll follow up through the NDA process.

One ask: please include a short mapping file that explains how the hashed subject ids map (if at all) to internal user ids for traceability — a hashed pairing is fine, we just need a consistent mapping inside the bundle so we can connect SCIM events to corresponding assertions.

Upload link and checksum manifest will be the preferred delivery mechanism — please mark the Drive folder as time-limited (7 days) and notify us once staged.

Appreciate it — will confirm receipt once artifacts are reviewed.

Best,
Karen
